script.label: directive
script.message:
Extend JSON through batch.run, inspection.reports and views.render: documents, not encoded strings; text stays default. Validate before consuming input. Survey every compatibility case through CLI, batch and views, with one-shot inputs, selections and unique plans. Independently inspect the gates and their history: retire only redundant gates; prove contract and error-code rejection, and record the evidence in docs/gates.md. Commit the two review units.

Pasted batch contract: add inspection.export(paths, plan_path, destination, output="text"). Validate output and all plan names before reading sources. Names match [a-z][a-z0-9_-]*; reserve manifest. The destination must not exist, and its parent exists. In one process, write one <plan>.txt or <plan>.json per sorted plan plus manifest.json, using bundles.manifest format 1 with name, byte_count and sha256 for each member. Return that manifest. JSON members are documents, not encoded strings. A source or member-write failure leaves no destination or scratch; an existing destination and all sources stay intact. Use the existing readers, plans, batch and bundle APIs. Add boundary tests, including an injected write failure, and docs/consumers/exports.md.

script.label: ruling
script.message: Importer ruling: add schema_version: 1 to every JSON report document, including CLI, batch, views and exported members; errors and snapshots keep their own contracts. Revise the earlier implementation, tests, CLI and contract docs, and compatibility survey. Text stays default; counts and integer minutes stay as agreed. Commit the revision.

script.label: correct
script.message: A second inspection log changes the earlier fix: in one process, read a 30-minute export, replace it with 45 minutes of the same byte length, restore its mtime, then read it again: still 30. Deleting that path also returns cached data. Fresh content and E101 must win. Fix the shared cause, test reports and findings, and update the source guide and release record.
